measurement.scope: Every PHP file under adapter-packages/*/package/runtime, measured as LF-delimited physical lines.

absorbed.reason: The provider's product effect was one per-row WordPress object-cache entry deletion. The existing generic primitive performs that effect and proves the entry absent; the product regression independently observes the committed value through PMPro's native cache semantics.

absorbed.engine_primitive: providers[].contracts + ManifestProviderRuntime + ProviderSdk checked list reads
absorbed.reason: Manifest-owned providers no longer duplicate identity, capability advertising, dispatch, scoped receipt construction, recovery routing, or receipt-shape verification. Ninja Forms and TEC also share the core checked-list read guard while retaining their reviewed diagnostics. Core validates and executes those generic mechanics; the remaining files contain plugin calls and value-level postconditions that cannot move into a plugin-agnostic engine.

surfaces.responsibility: Derive reference kinds and storage codecs from repository-authored ACF field definitions, then validate schema/value agreement.
surfaces.plugin_cooperation: ACF could expose a stable normalized field-schema and reference-shape API; until then, moving this dynamic ACF model into core would make the engine plugin-aware.

surfaces.responsibility: Classify legacy/current CF7 property aliases and validate the closed form, mail, locale, and hash shapes consumed by CF7 6.x.
surfaces.plugin_cooperation: CF7 could expose canonical property normalization and validation. Independently, a closed entity-constraint vocabulary could absorb most shape checks without naming CF7 in core.

surfaces.responsibility: Restrict field/action types to the reviewed plugin vocabulary and reject unsafe or noncanonical serialized settings.
surfaces.plugin_cooperation: Ninja Forms already exposes live type registries; a plugin provider could own that narrowing, while a generic constraint vocabulary could absorb bounded plain-data and enum checks.

surfaces.responsibility: Normalize Polylang option sub-keys, materialize language/menu mappings, and verify plugin hook/runtime topology.
surfaces.plugin_cooperation: Polylang should own a supported export/import and post-apply synchronization boundary; copying its hook topology into engine core would duplicate plugin internals.

surfaces.responsibility: Normalize TEC customizer/widget storage, structured block references, computed options, and exact hook topology.
surfaces.plugin_cooperation: TEC should expose canonical settings/widget import and runtime preparation APIs; the engine must not acquire TEC callback and option-family knowledge.

surfaces.responsibility: Normalize WooCommerce catalog, option, taxonomy, attachment, and co-installed callback topology before the engine applies canonical state.
surfaces.plugin_cooperation: WooCommerce should expose canonical catalog import and callback-isolation boundaries; moving its version-pinned storage and hook topology into core would make the engine Woo-aware.

surfaces.responsibility: Implement and verify Code Snippets cache/flat-file semantics behind the engine-owned manifest-provider protocol.
surfaces.plugin_cooperation: The plugin is the right owner for an atomic rebuild-and-verify provider. A generic table-scoped cache deletion alone would not remove the executable flat-file requirement.

surfaces.responsibility: Implement and verify Elementor CSS/render-cache semantics behind the engine-owned manifest-provider protocol.
surfaces.plugin_cooperation: Elementor should expose the verified regeneration capability. Core cannot reconstruct Elementor's document and CSS projection generically.

surfaces.responsibility: Run and verify Ninja Forms' cache builder behind the engine-owned manifest-provider protocol.
surfaces.plugin_cooperation: Ninja Forms should own a fresh-state rebuild API. Engine core may own the generic child-process envelope, but not the plugin table projection or builder semantics.

surfaces.responsibility: Implement and verify Polylang lifecycle synchronization behind the engine-owned manifest-provider protocol.
surfaces.plugin_cooperation: Polylang should expose this synchronization as a negotiated plugin provider rather than requiring Duo to reproduce hook ordering.

surfaces.responsibility: Implement and verify Redirection WordPress-module rule visibility and cache-generation semantics behind the engine-owned manifest-provider protocol.
surfaces.plugin_cooperation: Redirection should expose a bounded rule-cache synchronization and readback API. Core cannot own its module vocabulary, generation option, or lookup-cache semantics.

surfaces.responsibility: Implement and verify TEC Category Colors projections behind the engine-owned manifest-provider protocol.
surfaces.plugin_cooperation: TEC Category Colors should own the rebuild-and-verify boundary; its CSS and option projection is not a reusable engine primitive.

surfaces.responsibility: Invoke and verify WooCommerce cache-group APIs behind the engine-owned manifest-provider protocol.
surfaces.plugin_cooperation: This is almost entirely a checked wrapper around WC_Cache_Helper. WooCommerce can supply the provider directly; a Woo-specific native action in core would only relocate duplication.

surfaces.responsibility: Verify the exact WooCommerce feature, taxonomy, and database prerequisites required before fulfillment state can be trusted.
surfaces.plugin_cooperation: WooCommerce can expose this readiness verdict directly; core cannot own the plugin container, feature-controller, taxonomy, or HPOS compatibility rules.

surfaces.responsibility: Regenerate and verify WooCommerce category, brand, term-hierarchy, and product-permalink projections through native APIs.
surfaces.plugin_cooperation: WooCommerce should own a bounded hierarchy and permalink regeneration API; core should retain only the negotiated invocation and receipt envelope.

surfaces.responsibility: Implement and verify WooCommerce lookup/scheduling semantics behind the engine-owned manifest-provider protocol.
surfaces.plugin_cooperation: WooCommerce should expose a bounded idempotent lookup/scheduling provider. The row-cache deletion fragment is generic, but removing it alone would not retire this file.

surfaces.responsibility: Reconcile and verify WooCommerce analytics and stock-notification schedules against Action Scheduler and WordPress cron state.
surfaces.plugin_cooperation: WooCommerce should expose idempotent schedule reconciliation with its own versioned postconditions; core cannot safely reproduce Action Scheduler and Woo service topology.

surfaces.responsibility: Implement and verify Yoast Duplicate Post's role-capability projection behind the engine-owned manifest-provider protocol.
surfaces.plugin_cooperation: A generic option-to-role-capability projection is plausible but has one demand and still depends on the plugin's editable-role registry; the plugin can expose the exact operation now.

surfaces.responsibility: Implement and verify Yoast indexation semantics behind the engine-owned manifest-provider protocol.
surfaces.plugin_cooperation: Yoast should own a supported verified indexation provider; modeling Yoast index tables in core would duplicate private plugin semantics.

surfaces.responsibility: Regenerate TEC event/occurrence derived rows under checked schema, lock, transaction, hook, cache, and ambiguous-commit boundaries.
surfaces.plugin_cooperation: TEC should provide a transactional idempotent event regeneration boundary. The engine can own generic invocation and recovery envelopes, not TEC tables and hook topology.
